notes: ⛔⛔ **`confidence` is `low`, and the protocol says a low model must state why: the research gives this lane a BOUNDARY and no parameters at all.** Volume 4 dropped **Jeff Mills, Robert Hood, Underground Resistance, Carl Craig, Derrick May, Juan Atkins and Kevin Saunderson** — six of the founders of the form — with the note that *"no four-on-the-floor-plus-jazz-harmony lane fits them"* and *"this app has no `techno` archetype, so there is nowhere legitimate to put them"*. The roadmap calls it **the most consequential omission** in the set. What is sourced is exactly three things: that the lane is four-on-the-floor, that its harmony is **not** house's jazz harmony, and that Theo Parrish and Moodymann are *not* in it because *"their lane is documentably deep house rather than techno"*. Every number below is inference from that boundary and from the shape of the neighbours it must not be. ▶ **So the model is authored as house's four-on-the-floor with the harmony taken away.** `chords.maxChords` is 2 with the `i`-alone family carrying most of the weight, `extensions` are almost entirely bare triads, and `harmonicRhythm` is a vamp — against `house`, which reaches sevenths and ninths and moves. That single subtraction is the sourced difference, and it is what the invariant test measures. ⚠ **Faster and tighter than house, both inferred.** 130–140 centred on 135 against house's 120–128, `quantizeStrength` at 0.96 — the tightest on the roster, because a machine-locked grid is the one thing every description of this music agrees on — and `velocityVar` low for the same reason. ⚠ **The melodic content is a sequence, not a topline.** A short cell of two to five pitches, high `structure: riff_loop` weighting, a very low `chordToneBias` (this music does not resolve to chord tones because there is barely a chord), and the highest `emptyBarBias` of any electronic model here: the interest is in filtering and arrangement, which this engine does not author, so an inventive melody line would be the wrong kind of busy. ⚠ **The harmony floor caught the first cut at 270 of the 500 distinct progressions a model must reach in 1,000 seeds** — the lowest of the eleven, which is what a lane authored as 88% bare triads over a single vamp produces. The cure took four rounds and the one that worked is worth knowing: `chordDurationBeats` [2, 16], a wider voicing register, `susSubstitutionProb` 0.20 and the seventh share lifted to 0.20 took it from 270 to 474 — the seventh being **more** faithful rather than less, since the m7/m9 pad is exactly what Derrick May and Carl Craig are known for. Adding a third chord and a `i–VI–VII` family moved it by **one** (474 → 475), which says the chord vocabulary was never the constraint. What cleared it was the **key list**: five keys to eight, weighted, which is variety the archetype pays nothing for — nothing in the research confines this lane to five, and every neighbour authors six or seven. ▶ **On a lane that sits on one chord, widen the keys and the durations, not the harmony.** ⚠ **Nothing was moved onto this model.** The seven names above are what it was authored *for*, and each is a roster entry with its own gates; adding them is the next session's work, not a side effect of this file existing. ⚠ **A later session with real techno research should expect to rewrite the interior of this model.** The gate asserts only the sourced boundary, and says so.
